bio: Rather inconspicuously located on Grote Markt, there is a distinctly Parisian feel to this bistro with a predominantly green colour scheme. The long bar with ceramic tiles and open kitchen with green panelling make for an inviting setting. As you might expect, the menu features French bistro fare with the odd fresh twist – for instance, the chef incorporates kumquat into the rich duck jus that accompanies pan-fried duck breast and orange compote, without compromising the dish's signature flavours. The house-made pâté en croûte is certainly tempting. Full flavours guaranteed!...
